//: Project-wide, and it applies to everyone equally. Installed skills and the vendored audit tooling are build artifacts: a fix belongs upstream in the cairn repository, where every project gets it. Edited in place it survives until the next install and then silently reverts. Note that replacing a copy wholesale still works - this stops editing, not reinstalling. The other restriction - keeping a designer out of the developers' folders - is a property of who is sitting at the machine rather than of the project, so it lives in .claude/settings.local.json on their laptop and never in this file, which everybody shares.
